system_state_snapshot.recent_sales_summary: Aucune vente. Le systeme est en phase de mise en place des moteurs de production.
open_issues: Generation d'image: HF ne sert plus FLUX/SDXL gratuitement, Gemini image = 429 (payant), AI Horde bloque depuis les IP GitHub Actions (403). Seul Pollinations repond mais qualite brute.
Pistes image en cours: Together AI (gratuit, FLUX-schnell + img2img) et Cloudflare Workers AI (gratuit 10k neurons/j) a tester; Runware en PAYG plafonne 20€ comme option qualite/volume.
Cerveaux: modele Gemini experimental deprecie corrige, fallback multi-modeles ajoute.

proposals.name: TTRPG Game Master Printable Props & Handouts
proposals.buyer_persona: Tabletop RPG Game Masters (D&D, Call of Cthulhu, Cyberpunk) who want to increase table immersion by giving players physical, realistic clues, letters, and documents without spending hours designing them.
product_angles: Vintage 1920s newspaper clipping templates for Lovecraftian horror games
Sci-fi hacker terminal log printouts and spaceship blueprints
Aged fantasy tavern menus and royal bounty board letters
proposals.first_test_product: 1920s New England Investigator Handout Pack (PDF printable with editable fields)

proposals.name: CNC Machinists & Toolmakers Technical Humor & Reference
proposals.buyer_persona: CNC Mill/Lathe operators, manual machinists, and toolmakers who take extreme pride in mechanical precision (sub-micron level) and love insider shop floor humor and blueprints.
product_angles: G-Code quick reference desk mats and posters
Technical patent art prints of vintage micrometers and calipers
Machinist humor sticker packs for toolboxes ('Keep Your Hands Off My Calipers')
proposals.first_test_product: G-Code CNC Cheat Sheet Desk Mat Design (POD via Redbubble/Etsy)

proposals.name: Eurorack & Modular Synthesizer Enthusiasts
proposals.buyer_persona: Electronic music producers obsessed with modular hardware synths. They have high disposable income, love technical signal-flow diagrams, and constantly need to document their complex patch cables.
product_angles: Blank modular synth patch sheet design notebooks
Eurorack module signal-flow schematics as minimalist posters
Inside joke stickers about 'GAS' (Gear Acquisition Syndrome) and patch cables
proposals.first_test_product: 60HP / 84HP Modular Synth Patch Diary & Logbook (KDP Paperback)

proposals.name: Custom Assets for French Micro-Breweries
proposals.buyer_persona: Independent craft brewers in France who need professional, localized, and vintage-style graphic assets for their beer bottles, coasters, and event posters on a tight budget.
product_angles: Vintage regional French beer label vector templates
Customizable craft beer coaster design sets
Social media launch templates for micro-breweries
proposals.first_test_product: 10 Customizable Vintage French Beer Label Vector Templates (SVG/EPS)

proposals.name: Aquascaping & High-Tech Planted Aquarium Hobbyists
proposals.buyer_persona: Dedicated hobbyists who design underwater nature landscapes using live plants, hardscapes (rocks/wood), and precise CO2/fertilizer dosing. They appreciate Japanese minimalist aesthetics (Iwagumi).
product_angles: Aquascaping layout planning sketchbooks with grid lines
Water parameter tracking logs and fertilizer dosing planners
Minimalist Iwagumi style aquarium t-shirt and sticker designs
proposals.first_test_product: Aquascapers Layout Design Notebook & Parameter Log (KDP)

proposals.name: Amateur Radio (Ham Radio) Operators
proposals.buyer_persona: Highly technical, licensed amateur radio operators who track global signal contacts, build antennas, and exchange collectible physical postcards called 'QSL Cards'.
product_angles: Printable retro QSL Card design templates
Ham Radio Log Books for tracking signal contacts (ITU Zones, signal strength)
Phonetic alphabet and radio frequency spectrum reference posters
proposals.first_test_product: Customizable Retro QSL Card Canva & SVG Template Pack
